value.a: Yes. Move between plans as your team changes. Your incident history and configuration stay in place.
Annual plans are billed once a year at the displayed per-responder monthly equivalent. The discount is approximately 20% compared with monthly billing.
A responder is someone who can be assigned to incidents and take response actions. View-only stakeholders are free.

value.q: Can I try a plan before buying?
value.a: This reference site has no account creation or billing. Selecting a plan prepares a local-only contact request, so you can explore the plan discussion flow without payment details.
Yes. Contact sales for a security packet, deployment details, and a conversation with our team.

value.q: Can I estimate a larger response team?
value.a: Yes. The estimator supports up to 500 responders. For larger rollouts, contact sales for a custom Enterprise proposal.
No. People who only receive updates or view incident progress do not count as responders in these estimates.
